text: My father always promised to take me to the amusement park, but he was too busy. I waited, but that 'next time' never came.
In high school, I struggled with depression. I told my father I wanted to quit school, and he didn’t believe me. That moment—my pain meant nothing.
Now, I see the efforts my father made to make up for lost time, but the past can’t be rewritten. I needed his hug then, not material things.
